role: local disposable-Git fixture descriptors (test-only, temp repos only)
note: Realized by checks/check-git-fencing.sh in newly created temporary repositories. Never alters project refs. Claimant-side mutations go only through the fenced create/update primitive (expected-old-head + generation/owner + fast-forward ancestry); direct update-ref appears in harness setup solely to model world states (third-party advances, missing refs). Fence model is a primitive feasibility witness, not a production allocator or proof of remote atomicity.
occurrence_rule: VERIFIED requires observed == intended (positive postcondition readback). NOT_APPLIED requires observed == proven precondition with the operation identity absent. Any third/divergent/advanced/unreadable state is UNKNOWN: fail closed, never retryable. A bare observed != intended mismatch never proves NOT_APPLIED.

fixtures.goal: object/ref readback: blob hash, cat-file, ref resolve, exact readback VERIFIED
fenced creation race: two competing claimers, one current winner, loser rejected on existing ref
fenced advance: expected-old-head + ownership + ancestry; stale loser rejected with ref unchanged
backwards write to an already-seen value rejected by fast-forward ancestry with ref unchanged
stale-ownership write (revoked generation/owner, fresh descendant value) and already-seen-value ref-reuse rejected with ref unchanged; current owner still advances
publication equivalent with fenced update + exact readback
lost-response classification over (intended, precondition, observed): VERIFIED / NOT_APPLIED / UNKNOWN, with third/divergent/advanced-head and missing-ref negatives UNKNOWN and never retryable
